title: NordVPN
headline: Multi-year plans at their lowest price
blurb: Hides what you do online and lets you use the internet as if you were in another country. Billed up front for one or two years.

title: Surfshark VPN
headline: One subscription covers every device you own
blurb: The same idea as NordVPN, and usually cheaper. No limit on how many phones, tablets and computers you use it on.

title: NordPass
headline: Remembers every password so you don't have to
blurb: Stores your passwords behind one master password and fills them in for you. Family plans cover everyone in the house.

title: SwitchBot
headline: Up to 50% off their daily deals
blurb: Smart home gear that works with what you already own - robot vacuums, curtain openers, door locks and sensors.

title: Perfumania
headline: Buy more, save more - Black Friday weekend
blurb: Designer fragrance at outlet prices. Their Black Friday sale is live now.

title: zChocolat
headline: French chocolate in handmade wooden gift boxes
blurb: Made in France and packed in a mahogany box. The sort of present you send when it has to look like you tried.
